description: Revalue open foreign-currency monetary balances (cash, receivables, payables, loans) at the closing rates you send, for a month-end or year-end close. Send your functional currency, the closing rate for each foreign currency (as functional units per 1 foreign unit, or foreign units per 1 functional unit) and up to 100 items, each with its currency, whether it is an asset or a liability, the foreign amount and the amount it is carried at in the books. Get back each item's revalued amount, the change to book, the unrealized gain or loss, totals per currency and in total, and the entry to post. Amounts round to each currency's ISO 4217 decimals (0 for JPY, 3 for KWD). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/fx-revaluation). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

carrying_amount.description: What the item is carried at in the books now, in the functional currency (at the original or the last revaluation rate).

currency.description: Currency the item is owed or held in.

foreign_amount.description: Open balance in the foreign currency (up to that currency's decimals).

label.description: Optional label (your own text, echoed back; not a person or an account number).

side.description: asset (cash, receivable, loan made, refundable deposit paid) or liability (payable, loan owed, refundable deposit held).

label.description: Optional label for the revaluation (your own text, echoed back).

rates.description: Closing rate per foreign currency (up to 50), as of the revaluation date you choose.

quote.description: functional_per_foreign (default): functional units for 1 foreign unit (USD 1.10 per EUR); foreign_per_functional: foreign units for 1 functional unit (JPY 150 per USD).

rate.description: Closing rate (up to 6 decimals; for a very small rate such as USD per VND, send it the other way with quote foreign_per_functional).

name: fx_revaluation
title: Foreign Currency Revaluation
